parsed.summary: The paper introduces Agent-Reflex, a training framework designed to enhance the reflective capabilities of language agents in noisy, real-world environments. It comprises three stages: Environment Reflection Skill Discovery (RSD), Reflective Supervised Fine-Tuning (ReSFT), and On-Policy Reflective Policy Optimization (ORPO). Experiments demonstrate that Agent-Reflex improves long-horizon tool use, robustness to noise, and training stability across multiple benchmarks.

chk_problem.value: Existing methods lack supervision for reflection learning and failure recovery in noisy environments.
chk_problem.paper_quote: In real deployments, MCP tool services can return noisy feedback and users may intervene to correct the agent, but existing methods provide limited supervision for reflection learning and failure recovery.

chk_method.value: Agent-Reflex framework with RSD, ReSFT, and ORPO stages to train reflective agents.
chk_method.paper_quote: To bridge this gap, we propose Agent-Reflex, a general training framework for incentivizing proactive reflection in agents.

chk_data.value: 557 MCP environments, 24,510 error returns, and 1,170 reflection meta-skills.
chk_data.paper_quote: Specifically, Agent-Reflex comprises three stages. First, Environment Reflection Skill Discovery (RSD) injects grounded tool-feedback perturbations into environment scaling, samples a capability-diverse LLM pool, mines matched success–failure pairs, and summarizes reusable reflection meta-skills.

chk_setup.value: Experiments on six benchmarks with noisy and long-horizon tasks using Qwen3-8B.
chk_setup.paper_quote: Experiments on six challenging agent benchmark suites demonstrate the effectiveness of Agent-Reflex.

chk_primary_result.value: Agent-Reflex achieves 58.6 overall on five long-horizon tool-use benchmarks and 29.1 on AgentNoiseBench.
chk_primary_result.paper_quote: Built on Qwen3-8B, Agent-Reflex reaches 58.6 overall on five long-horizon tool-use benchmarks and 29.1 on AgentNoiseBench, surpassing strong environment-scaling and reflection baselines.

chk_secondary_result.value: Agent-Reflex improves agents’ robustness to noise while maintaining stable training dynamics.
chk_secondary_result.paper_quote: Further analyses show that Agent-Reflex improves agents’ robustness to noise while maintaining stable training dynamics, supporting scalable agent training.

chk_baseline.value: Compared against reflection methods (e.g., Reflexion, ExpeL) and environment-scaling methods (e.g., EnvScaler, Agent-World).
chk_baseline.paper_quote: We compare three families: reflection methods (Shinn et al., 2023; Zhao et al., 2024; Yuan et al., 2025; Chen et al., 2026), environment-scaling methods (Li et al., 2025; Xu et al., 2025; Song et al., 2026; Wang et al., 2026b; Xu et al., 2026; Dong et al., 2026a), and trajectory-level RL algorithms (Shao et al., 2024; Yu et al., 2025; Hu et al., 2025; Wu et al., 2026).

chk_conclusion.value: Agent-Reflex improves long-horizon tool use and robustness under noise, supporting scalable agent training.
chk_conclusion.paper_quote: Across six challenging agent benchmark suites, Agent-Reflex improves long-horizon tool use and robustness under tool and user noise with stable training dynamics, supporting scalable agent training.

chk_limitation.value: The skill library does not automatically adapt to changes in tool interfaces or environment dynamics.
chk_limitation.paper_quote: Our reflection skill library is mined offline from a fixed snapshot of a large collection of executable environments. Consequently, it does not automatically adapt to changes in tool interfaces, service behavior, or environment dynamics.
